content.content:
Spec. A task from the history that doesn't say which tab it was sent
        from keeps the tab bar's colour. The queue along the bottom and the
        previous tasks row along the top both have the same background colour
        as the tab bar.

    askDimming:
        While a finished question from the Ask tab is open onto its full task
        table, a dark shade fades in over the message list to draw attention
        to it, and fades back out when it is closed or closed down to its row.
        The shade also shows while the previous answers are expanded on the Ask
        tab. Questions still running, each a single row, never dim the list.
        It covers only the message list, not a file open beside it, and doesn't
        block clicks.

    scrolling:
        The latest task's output scrolls with a @{ScrollColumnScope}, with its
        working on one. Any number of questions can be asked, and they all run
        at the same time; asking another never stops or waits for one already
        running.

        Each question's progress and results are shown in a task table, as in
        the @{MessageList}. The questions stack directly above the tabs, the
        newest nearest them, over the bottom of the message list rather than
        pushing it up, and each slides up out of the chat input with an
        animation as it is asked. While the harness works on a question, it is a

- **Previous answers:** expanding them moves their row and list into the drawer.
- **Drawer size:** the 80% default and the drag-to-resize work the same as before.
